en: The image shows an old, heavily worn and cracked black surface, likely the reverse side of a photographic print or cabinet card. Faint gold-embossed text and a heraldic crest are visible. The text includes Cyrillic and Latin characters, mentioning 'Charles Albrecht' and the cities 'Varna' and 'Bourgas'. There are also several small portrait medallions and ornate flourishes surrounding the text.
